title: Why One Plug Pin Is Longer
coreQuestion: Why is one pin of a British plug longer than the others?

facts.claim: The earth pin is longer than the line and neutral pins.

narration.text: On a British plug, one pin is longer than the other two.
That longer pin is the earth.
Because it is longer, the earth connects before the live pins do.
Pull the plug out and it stays connected until after the live pins let go.
So whenever power can flow, there is already a path to earth.
